seed-folder.evidence: Seed Folder is an empty visible folder.

support-draft-flows.evidence: Customer Support contains disabled draft flows New Ticket Triage and Weekly Escalation Digest. New Ticket Triage is configured: valid schedule trigger (Weekday Triage Schedule, cron weekdays 09:00 UTC) plus a valid Triage ticket Code step returning { ticketId: 42, status: triaged, success: true } with trigger OUTPUT sample data saved; version.valid is true so the builder Test Flow widget renders enabled.

finance-draft-flow.evidence: Finance Operations contains the disabled draft flow Supplier Invoice Review.

variables-write-access.evidence: Seeded owner holds project owner permissions including WRITE_VARIABLE; Variables tab visible in project navigation.

clean-variables-table.evidence: Seed creates no variables, so TESTER_ENV_REVIEW_NOTE does not collide on a fresh deploy.

platform-pieces-visible.evidence: First signup becomes platform owner per tester-env CLI; owner can open the Platform Pieces management page (/platform/setup/pieces).

install-piece-dialog-available.evidence: Pieces page toolbar always renders the Install Piece trigger opening the Install a piece dialog.

templates-gallery-has-template.evidence: CE backend proxies official templates from https://cloud.activepieces.com/api/v1/templates; host egress verified HTTP 200 with template data on 2026-09-18, so /templates lists templates for the CE plan.

personal-project-present.evidence: Seed signup creates the owner with a PERSONAL project; getProjectName renders it as Personal Project in the Use Template dialog.

triage-configured-code-step.evidence: New Ticket Triage step_1 is a valid CODE step named Triage ticket whose sourceCode returns the fixed object { ticketId: 42, status: triaged, success: true }; selecting it opens the step settings panel without the piece picker.

triage-configured-trigger.evidence: New Ticket Triage trigger is PIECE_TRIGGER @activepieces/piece-schedule@0.1.21 cron_expression with input { cronExpression: 0 9 * * 1-5, timezone: UTC }, valid true, connection-free.

triage-testable-draft.evidence: Draft stays DISABLED/DRAFT with version.valid true and trigger sampleData.lastTestDate set, so the builder Test Flow button renders enabled. Executing the test run additionally requires the deployment to serve the engine piece-bundle endpoint in-container (see seed manifest constraints).

triage-trigger-sample-data.evidence: Seed saves trigger OUTPUT sample data ({}) via SAVE_SAMPLE_DATA, setting sampleData.lastTestDate, which is the exact frontend gate for enabling Test Flow.
